h1: The 5 Best 22-Inch-Class Lawn Mowers for Medium Yards, Gas and Cordless, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 5 lawn mowers with 21 to 22 inch decks, gas and cordless, scored on engine or battery, drive type, discharge modes and value.
summary: The SENIX 201cc 22 inch self-propelled gas mower is the best pick for a medium yard, with variable-speed drive and 3-in-1 discharge. The EGO Power+ 21 inch is the cordless choice for quiet, easy starts, the PowerSmart is the cheapest gas option, and the Worx and Greenworks suit smaller lawns.
intro: The 22 inch deck is the size most households actually want: wide enough to finish a half-acre lawn in reasonable time, narrow enough to fit through a standard gate. The decision is not the deck but the power source. Gas gives unlimited run time and strong cutting in thick grass, while a cordless mower starts at the push of a button and runs quietly, but its battery caps the area per charge.

Five mowers are ranked here. Three cordless models have 21 inch decks, which is standard for that class and sits in the same range as a 22 inch gas deck. Scoring weighs engine or battery, drive, discharge options and price bracket. Run time per charge is rarely listed, so we judge cordless models on platform voltage.

products.name: SENIX 201cc 22" 3-in-1 Variable Speed Self Propelled Gas Lawn Mower
products.verdict: A 201cc engine, variable-speed self-propel and mulch, bag or side discharge on a 22 inch deck.
products.description:
The SENIX has a 22 inch deck, a 201cc gas engine, variable-speed self-propelled drive and 3-in-1 discharge for mulching, bagging or side discharge. It sits in the $200 to $500 bracket.

Variable-speed drive is the feature that matters for comfort: you set the pace instead of fighting a single speed, which tires people on slopes and around obstacles. The 201cc engine is the largest here and handles tall, thick grass. It wins because it covers every option a medium yard needs.

Buy it if you have a half-acre or more. Skip it if you want a quiet start.
products.skipIf: You want a quiet electric start.

products.name: EGO Power+ 21" Cordless Electric Lawn Mower, Self-Propelled (LM2134SP-2)
products.verdict: A 21 inch self-propelled cordless mower on the 56V platform, with battery and charger included.
products.description:
The EGO LM2134SP-2 has a 21 inch deck, self-propelled drive, a 56V battery platform, and a battery and charger in the box. It sits in the $500 and above bracket.

The 56V platform is among the strongest cordless systems for cutting power, and EGO batteries power a whole range of yard tools. Push-button starting removes pull cords and fuel. It ranks second because it costs more than the gas mowers and the listing gives no run time.

Buy it if you want quiet, low-maintenance mowing. Skip it if your lawn is large and you lack spare batteries.

products.name: PowerSmart 22-Inch 170cc Self Propelled Gas Lawn Mower
products.verdict: A no-frills gas mower that drives itself, priced in the middle of the field.
products.description:
Power here comes from a 170cc gas engine under a 22 inch deck, with a drive wheel to share the pushing. It sits in the $200 to $500 bracket.

It is the plain gas option: enough engine for normal grass and a self-propel that spares your legs. It ranks third because the SENIX adds variable speed and 3-in-1 discharge for a similar bracket, and this listing names neither.

Buy it if you want straightforward gas power. Skip it if you want discharge options.
products.idealFor: Plain gas mowing on a medium lawn.

products.name: Greenworks 80V 21-Inch Push Lawn Mower
products.verdict: An 80V cordless push mower with a 4.0Ah battery and charger included.
products.description:
The Greenworks has a 21 inch deck, an 80V battery platform, and a 4.0Ah battery and charger. It is a push mower, not self-propelled. It sits in the $200 to $500 bracket.

80V is the highest voltage here, which suggests strong cutting power. Being a push mower keeps weight and cost down. It ranks fourth because a push model asks more of you on a medium yard.

Buy it if you have a flat, moderate lawn. Skip it if you have slopes.

products.name: Worx Cordless Lawn Mower, 40V 21" 3-in-1 Grass Mower (WG752)
products.verdict: A 40V cordless mower with a 21 inch deck and mulch, bag or side discharge.
products.description:
The Worx WG752 has a 21 inch deck, a 40V battery platform and 3-in-1 discharge. It sits in the $200 to $500 bracket.

The 40V platform is the lowest voltage here, which suits smaller lawns. The 3-in-1 discharge gives flexibility. It ranks last because the listing gives no drive type and no battery or charger detail.

Buy it if you have a small yard and want options. Skip it if you want a large lawn cleared in one go.

whatMatters.detail: Gas offers unlimited run time and strong cutting but needs fuel, oil and a pull start. Cordless starts with a button and is quiet, but battery size limits area per charge.
A drive wheel does the pushing, which matters on slopes. Variable speed lets you set your pace. Push mowers are lighter and cheaper.
A 201cc engine cuts thicker grass than a 170cc one. For cordless, higher voltage such as 56V or 80V suggests more power. Check what the battery also powers.
Mulching returns clippings to the lawn, bagging collects them and side discharge throws them out. 3-in-1 mowers do all three.
A 21 or 22 inch deck cuts a 2 foot swath and fits through most gates. Wider decks finish faster but need more storage.

faq.q: Is a 21 inch mower the same as 22 inch?
faq.a: Close. A one inch difference in deck width changes cutting time little. Cordless models commonly use 21 inch decks.

faq.q: What is the biggest mistake when buying a mower?
faq.a: Buying a push mower for a hilly lawn. Self-propelled drive saves effort. Choose by terrain, not only deck size.

faq.q: Is the EGO worth it over a gas mower?
faq.a: If quiet and no maintenance matter, yes. For a large lawn, a gas mower runs longer.

faq.q: How do I maintain a gas mower?
faq.a: Change oil each season, replace the spark plug and air filter, and use fresh fuel.

faq.q: How long does a cordless battery last?
faq.a: The listings give no figure. Expect it to cover a modest lawn on one charge, and keep a spare for more.
Mulch when grass is dry and short to feed the lawn. Bag when grass is tall or wet.

finalTake: The SENIX 201cc 22 inch self-propelled mower is the best here for medium and larger yards, with variable-speed drive and 3-in-1 discharge. The EGO Power+ is the best cordless option for quiet mowing, and the PowerSmart is the plain gas value pick. Choose by lawn size and slope first.
